caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a white background and a thin red border running along the edges. The main pattern consists of eight large, leaf-shaped motifs arranged in two columns of four, each leaf comprised of concentric shapes colored green on the outermost edge, followed by a red band, a yellow band, and a white central area divided by a yellow vein. Between each column and row of leaf motifs, small circular floral shapes appear, each featuring alternating red and green petals with a central yellow circle. The surface of the quilt is filled with densely packed parallel lines, suggesting a quilted texture. The overall composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
